method: Original publisher interpretation of rugose rock and boulders over paired valid nominal depth. Habitat suitability evidence only; no fish presence, terrain grade, species fit, precise fishing position or new measurement credit.

Unknown interpolation masks remain unknown. Shared survey interpretation is not independent depth or fish evidence.
